name: Import messy contacts without inventing missing values
property_tested: Tolerant parsing; strict output types and missing-value semantics

turns.prompt: Import {WORKSPACE}/contacts.csv for our address-book app. Save contacts.json as an array with only id, name, phone, and email for each row. Trim surrounding whitespace, keep phone numbers as text, and use null for a missing email. The notes column is for internal use and isn't part of this import.
